perks.name: Ride Together, Die Together
perks.description: When you pick up an Orb of Power, gain a brief period of rapidly decaying damage reduction.
perks.exact:
On Orb of Power Pickup:
Grants Ride Together, Die Together for 3 seconds.
Ride Together, Die Together initially grants 40% [5%] Damage Resist.
Damage Resist scales down to ~30?% with 1.5 seconds left, further reduced to 24?% with 1 second left, decreasing down to 0% over the remaining second.

perks.name: Too Old for This
perks.description: Defeating a powerful combatant with a finisher grants you Special ammo progress and replenishes a small amount of health.
perks.exact:
On Elite+ Finisher:
Restores 32 HP and +16% Special Ammo Progress.
